explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 60 named tracks, release cuts, current listings and catalogue references across a newly surfaced September 11 debut, adjacent Detroit/Soiree material in current distribution, and a newly recirculated early Blueprint catalogue work. Written metadata and attributed exact-track descriptions only; no audio audition.
sourceWindows: CURRENT RELEASE WINDOW: Active Systems' September 11, 2026 debut supplied three differentiated rhythmic propositions spanning glacial hip-hop, restless skippage and mechanical funk. https://www.dancingvinyl.com/release/1786728497/active-systems-the-red-ep

ADJACENT / EMERGING WINDOW: Soiree's current Immortal compilation supplied four Detroit-rooted exact tracks with differentiated pad, bass, dialogue, jazz, acid and vocal constructions. https://clonedistribution.com/release/84644?play=28

OVERLOOKED / NEWLY CONTEXTUALIZED WINDOW: the September 11, 2026 reissue of James Ruskin's 1998 Further Design supplied lean early Blueprint material newly available for exact identity testing. https://www.normanrecords.com/features/upcoming-album-releases/known-delays
exclusions: Recent Runs 196–205 source fields, every prior ranked lead and alternate, canonical identities, active placement-specific rejects, untriggered PARKED revisits, and existing global utility identities were excluded.

The five-run repetition check avoided the placement boundaries tested in completed exploration Runs 197, 198, 201, 202 and 203. The current placements span opening, early, middle, late and post-protected boundaries because candidate-specific evidence created honest questions there, not to satisfy a distribution quota.
Nine leads survived because each has differentiated exact-track evidence and a concrete transition/local-run/long-form question; no list slot was padded.

The protected Transparency → When We Froze → Stardancer internal order and both listener-protected handoffs remain untouched. No Spotify connector, raw audio, audio-feature inference or invented identity was used.
